clauses.reason: The order states "is hereby revoked, and such land" returned to the Governor of The Panama Canal, revoking Executive Order No. 2006 of July 30, 1914 (placing land at Darien under the Secretary of the Navy for a naval radio station) and returning the land to the control and jurisdiction of the Governor. The words are in the present tense and state no later effective date, so the revocation and the return of control took effect when the order was made, on September 11, 1939 (the date printed under the signature: "September 11, 1939."). The order was filed on September 12, 1939 and printed in the issue of Wednesday, September 13, 1939 (4 FR 3890); those dates are disclosed as alternative candidates for effectiveness but the order's own text states none. The command is self-executing and was exhausted by performance on issuance, so it is recorded as terminated on that date, with the revoked state of EO 2006 and the return of the land as surviving consequences (see savings). The acting instrument is EO 8250 itself.

research_rationale:
EO 8250 (1939-09-11, Franklin D. Roosevelt), "Revocation of Executive Order No. 2006 of July 30, 1914, Placing Certain Land Under the Jurisdiction of the Secretary of the Navy for Use as a Naval Radio Station" (Canal Zone). Text and identity: the held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register issue PDF (4 FR 3890, PDF pages 2-2; https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-1939-09-13/pdf/FR-1939-09-13.pdf; PDF sha256 bce26ff5a3f2e529e0eecd6919e8405d44e9ee5e71a0710ad00a8bc42f90abb1), grade original_representation_unverified, acceptable_as_original true, requires_page_check false; the heading, date and subject match the register row, and the number printed after the signature is OCR-garbled ("[No. 82501" for 8250). I read the whole held text (page images were not inspected). The order has one operative sentence: it revokes EO 2006 and returns the land to the Governor of The Panama Canal. It is self-executing and was performed on issuance, September 11, 1939. The packet's later-events search (Federal Register disposition notes of 6938 catalog records from 1937 onward, plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts) returned no hit for this order, and the held-text number search found no later order citing it. No held source shows an earlier end or a revival of EO 2006.

savings.reason: The revocation of Executive Order No. 2006 and the return of the land to the control and jurisdiction of the Governor of The Panama Canal, both stated in the order, are accrued effects that continue independently of the order once performed.
